children: AstraZeneca PLC (LSE:AZN) is juggling wins and setbacks as Enhertu advances with strong PFS/ORR in HER2‑mutant lung cancer, CHMP and NHS progress in breast cancer, and safety/OS questions, while late‑stage failures and mixed analyst views leave its pipeline and stock outlook in flux.
Previous Week Recap
Enhertu PFS, ORR Advantage
: AstraZeneca (AZN) said DESTINY-Lung04: Enhertu first-line for HER2-mutant advanced NSCLC showed median PFS 14.3 vs 8.3 months (HR 0.63); ORR 70.0% vs 44.5%; no mature OS data.
CHMP Positive For Adjuvant Use
: AstraZeneca’s AZN drug Enhertu got CHMP positive opinion for EU approval as adjuvant monotherapy for adult HER2‑positive breast cancer with residual disease after neoadjuvant taxane+HER2 therapy.
Etcamah Stumbles; Shares Dip
: AstraZeneca (AZN): Etcamah failed a late-stage advanced breast-cancer trial. It's the third late-stage setback in ~3 months. Shares swung ~+3% after news; market open seen down ~2–3%.
NHS Access For Breast Drug
: AstraZeneca PLC (AZN) secured NHS access in England for its breast cancer drug with Daiichi Sankyo, allowing treatment coverage for patients with aggressive breast cancer under NHS England.
Enhertu AEs: ILD 20.8%
: AstraZeneca's Enhertu showed grade 3+ treatment-related adverse events in 34.1% vs 33.6% control; ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 20.8% of patients, mostly Grade 1–2; four Grade 5 ILD cases reported.
OS Data Matures: 29.3 vs 33.1
: As of June 9, 2026 OS data 46.9% mature: median OS 29.3 months for Enhertu vs 33.1 months for pembrolizumab+chemo; interim OS not formally tested; subsequent therapies may affect differences.
FLAURA2: Tagrisso Chemo Benefit
: AstraZeneca (AZN) Phase 3 FLAURA2: Tagrisso plus chemo showed sustained safety and ongoing clinical benefit in advanced lung cancer, supporting use of the regimen in advanced disease management.
JPM Overweight On AZN Ahead
: J.P. Morgan kept Overweight on AstraZeneca (AZN), citing six Phase III readouts in 2027 tied to over $10B combined risk‑adjusted peak sales potential, relevant to pipeline beyond 2030.
Deutsche Bank: Hold, 11,700p
: Deutsche Bank upgraded AstraZeneca (AZN) to hold, raised target to 11,700p. Cited improved risk-reward after SERENA-4 setback; stock down ~3% since October and lags EU peers ~10%.
Zibotentan, Balcinerenone Outlooks
: AstraZeneca (AZN): bank estimates 80% success chance for zibotentan+Farxiga in kidney disease and 50% for balcinerenone+Farxiga in heart failure; notes partial MR antagonism may reduce benefits.
